description: A proprietary project that says nothing leaves the machine. Its backups, agent, editor, package manager, crash reporter, tests and research notes each carry the work out.

defects.tell: every night the whole repository is pushed in plaintext to a hosted git service, readable by the host, its integrations and any leaked token; an encrypted remote or the owner's own hardware keeps an off-site copy without that
the agent sends the whole repository to a remote model endpoint on every task, and the local model beside it is switched off
editor telemetry is set to all, and a cloud completion provider is sent the code around the cursor

extra-index-url makes pip ask the public index for heron-core-dsp too, which tells the public index the internal package's name, and lets anyone who publishes heron-core-dsp with a higher version there take over the install
every uncaught exception sends the traceback, the working directory (~/clients/acmefoods/heron) and the arguments to a hosted error tracker, naming the customer and carrying code and data out
the test suite downloads reference weights from a public model hub on first run; with the network off, make test fails, so 'developed fully offline' was never tried
searches name the customer and its line, the internal package name was searched publicly, and unmix.py (the customer's edge) was pasted into a public chat assistant

control.tell: the datasheets are done right: the vendor's whole archive fetched once in bulk from a clean profile, checked by hash, and searched locally, so nothing reveals which sensor Heron uses. A report that flags the datasheet fetch as a leak is inventing.
